svg.aria-label: A page split when inserting into a full B-tree leaf. Before: the leaf holds 250, 255, 262 and 268 and is full. Inserting 259 does not fit, so the database splits the leaf into two half-full pages, 250 255 and 259 262 268, and adds a new separator key, 259, to the parent page with a pointer to the new page. If the parent is also full, it splits too, and a split that reaches the root makes the tree one level taller. Every page written is logged in the write-ahead log first so a crash halfway through cannot leave the tree corrupted.

svg.text: parent full too? it splits; a root split adds a level
